article_title: How scientists finally confirmed rare pink seaweed as new species

tasks.prompt: What achievement does the article describe?
options: Scientists proved that all pink seaweeds are the same species
A rare pink seaweed long suspected to be unusual was confirmed as a distinct species
Researchers created artificial seaweed for aquariums
A common seaweed was removed from every British coastline
tasks.correct_answer: A rare pink seaweed long suspected to be unusual was confirmed as a distinct species
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת כיצד חשד ממושך לגבי אצה ורודה נדירה אושר לבסוף באמצעות מחקר מדעי כמין נפרד.

tasks.prompt: Why was the seaweed difficult to study and identify?
options: It grows only in freshwater laboratories
It is elusive, rare, and often encountered only as small fragments or brief glimpses
Its colour changes every hour
Scientists refused to collect any samples
tasks.correct_answer: It is elusive, rare, and often encountered only as small fragments or brief glimpses
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האצה חמקמקה ונדירה, ולכן החוקרים הסתמכו במשך זמן רב על שברים קטנים ותצפיות קצרות.

tasks.prompt: What finally provided strong evidence that it was a new species?
options: A change in its market price
A vote by local divers
Molecular analysis that distinguished it genetically from known seaweeds
A photograph showing that it was pink
tasks.correct_answer: Molecular analysis that distinguished it genetically from known seaweeds
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בדיקה מולקולרית אפשרה להשוות חומר גנטי ולהראות שהדגימה שונה ממינים מוכרים.

tasks.prompt: What does “elusive” convey about the seaweed?
options: It is difficult to find and study
It is abundant on every beach
It is dangerous to touch
It grows only in artificial light
tasks.correct_answer: It is difficult to find and study
tasks.explanation_hebrew: elusive פירושו חמקמק או קשה לאיתור, תיאור שמתאים למין שנצפה לעיתים רחוקות.

tasks.prompt: The seaweed is described as “calcified”. What does that mean?
options: It produces electric signals
It has hardened through calcium deposits
It has lost all colour
It can live without seawater
tasks.correct_answer: It has hardened through calcium deposits
tasks.explanation_hebrew: calcified מציין התקשות עקב הצטברות סידן, תכונה שמעניקה לאצה מרקם דמוי אלמוג.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “trawling” records suggest the scientists did?
options: Searched systematically through a large amount of information
Dragged fishing nets over the habitat
Published the same photograph repeatedly
Rejected all earlier observations
tasks.correct_answer: Searched systematically through a large amount of information
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאן trawling משמש בהשאלה לחיפוש יסודי ושיטתי ברישומים, תצלומים או דגימות.

tasks.prompt: Why were photographs and field observations useful but not sufficient on their own to confirm a new species?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמראה חיצוני יכול לספק רמזים אך להשתנות בין פרטים או להידמות למינים קרובים; אימות טקסונומי דורש דגימה והשוואה מולקולרית.
expected_points: Images documented the seaweed’s appearance and habitat
Closely related species can look similar
A physical sample allowed detailed structural and molecular comparison
Genetic evidence provided stronger confirmation than appearance alone

tasks.prompt: Write a 90–130 word summary tracing the discovery from early suspicion to molecular confirmation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר תצפיות ושברים נדירים, חיפוש אחר דגימה מתאימה, בדיקות מבנה ו־DNA, והמשמעות של ההכרה במין חדש.
expected_points: Scientists had long suspected the rare pink seaweed was unusual
Its scarcity made collection and identification difficult
A suitable specimen enabled structural and molecular analysis
The evidence confirmed a distinct species and added to knowledge of marine biodiversity

tasks.prompt: Explain how “fragment”, “glimpses”, “anticipation”, and “confirmation” create a discovery narrative in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להראות מעבר מראיות חלקיות ותצפיות קצרות, דרך ציפייה ממושכת, להוכחה מדעית סופית.
expected_points: Fragment and glimpses emphasize incomplete early evidence
Anticipation shows the researchers’ long wait for a decisive specimen or result
Confirmation marks the shift from suspicion to supported scientific conclusion
The sequence gives the feature a sense of persistence and resolution

tasks.prompt: Using the article’s evidence, discuss why identifying rare seaweed species matters beyond simply giving them names.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר זיהוי מדויק להבנת מגוון ביולוגי, תפקוד בתי גידול, תכונות אפשריות, ניטור ירידה והגנה על מינים מאוימים.
expected_points: Accurate identification improves knowledge of marine biodiversity
Species records help scientists understand habitats and ecological relationships
Distinct species may have useful or scientifically important properties
A species must be recognized before its abundance, decline or conservation needs can be assessed
